facts.text: Canton was founded in 1805 alongside Nimishillen Creek and grew into a heavy‑industry hub thanks to its many railroad lines.
The city’s name honors a trader named John O'Donnell, admired by surveyor Bezaleel Wells, who named the town after Canton, China.
In 1920, a car dealership showroom in Canton became the birthplace of the American Professional Football Association, the precursor to the NFL.
The NFL’s Hall of Fame sits in Canton, and city officials donated land to secure the museum and stadium.
Canton’s downtown now hosts the Birth of the NFL sculpture, unveiled in 2014 at the exact spot where the league was founded.
After heavy manufacturing declined, Canton shifted toward education, finance, healthcare, and retail, reshaping its economy in the late 20th century.
